node-1.label: Patient in their 80s presented with dyspnea and syncope during exercise

node-2.label: Medical history included essential hypertension and Parkinson disease

node-3.label: Patient reported dyspnea on exertion and exercise intolerance for the past year, with difficulty walking more than 100m

node-4.label: Patient experienced syncope during a bicycle ride with loss of consciousness for a few minutes, followed by complete recovery

node-5.label: Physical examination showed vital signs normal except elevated blood pressure of 150/78 mm Hg; chest auscultation revealed normal breath and heart sounds without murmurs
